`nba_schedule_2026.csv` / `nba_schedule_2027.csv`: real rows from sportsdataverse's ESPN NBA
schedule releases (downloaded 2026-10-16), with bulky columns (game_json, linescores, logos)
blanked. Cases: final, postponed, Finals, neutral site, play-in, All-Star (skipped), TBD
(skipped), and opening night 2026-27.
`mbb_schedule_2027.csv`: the real column layout with hand-set values, using real ESPN team ids;
game 401800001 is the ESPN id the CFBD basketball fixture records for UConn-Kansas.
